context.prior_context_text: I like writing code and watching how people use an app. I want to understand which activities I prefer.

activity_context.current_goal: Understand preference between coding tasks and user observation activities to guide career pathway choices.
confirmed_facts: I like writing code and watching how people use an app.
activity_context.possible_need: Help the user distinguish day-to-day work tasks across front-end engineering, product design, and technical product management.
missing_information: Specific coding languages or frameworks used
Experience level with user research or usability testing
activity_context.relevant_question: When building or testing something, do you get more satisfaction from solving code logic or refining the user experience?

response.question: When you're building or testing something, do you get more satisfaction from getting the logic and code working smoothly, or from tweaking the interface and observing how a person interacts with it?
summary: Enjoying both the build and the user experience is actually a very practical combination. It means you do not have to force a choice between purely technical work and human-centred design right away.
Several roles sit directly at that intersection, though they balance the daily work differently:
